title: What Is Deducted from a Hotel Rate Plans Settlement for the Amount Withheld
content:
What a cancellation settlement on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation deducts for the amount withheld turns on the form in which the rate plan booked returns value, and on whether a cancellation penalty already stands on the folio.

## The rule

1. Where the rate plan booked returns value to the original form of payment and a cancellation penalty already stands on the folio, the whole amount withheld is deducted from the settlement.
2. Where the rate plan booked returns value as credit at the property and a cancellation penalty already stands on the folio, the deduction is the whole prepayment still held.
3. Where no cancellation penalty stands on the folio, nothing is deducted.

The amount withheld is read as the cancellation penalty lines standing on that reservation's folio, taken together.

## The form each plan returns value in

| Rate plan | Form value is returned in |
| --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | nothing is returned |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | the original form of payment |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | the original form of payment |
| Standard Flexible Rate | the original form of payment |
| Member Flex Rate | the original form of payment |
| Suite Flexible Rate | the original form of payment |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | credit at the property |

## The combinations

| A cancellation penalty stands on the folio | Form the plan returns value in | Deduction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | the original form of payment | the whole amount withheld |
| yes | credit at the property | the whole prepayment still held |
| no | the original form of payment | nothing |
| no | credit at the property | nothing |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A reservation whose prepayment still held is 900.00 USD, with cancellation penalty lines on the folio totalling 240.00 USD:

- On the Standard Flexible Rate, which returns value to the original form of payment, the deduction is 240.00 USD.
- On the All-Inclusive Flex Rate, which returns value as credit at the property, the deduction is 900.00 USD.
- Where the folio carried no cancellation penalty line at all, the deduction on either plan would be 0.00 USD.
